text:
The image shows a metal bowl with about 11 dark, oval items that look like Kalamata olives or possibly kidney beans. They look glossy and purple-brown, so olives are the more likely match.

Kalamata olives weigh roughly 4-5 g each with the pit. 11 olives come to about 50 g. At about 115 kcal per 100 g, that is roughly 55 kcal.

If they were cooked kidney beans, they would weigh about 1.5 g each, so about 17 g and 20 kcal. I'm going with olives.
